summary: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd, an Australian-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K with a press release from BlockFuel Energy Inc., its approximately 51%-owned subsidiary, dated October 28, 2026. The release reports operational progress: permitting for the proposed Steinman #1-23 vertical well in Central Oklahoma, with drilling expected to begin in early December 2026 pending approvals, and installation of initial natural gas-powered computing and data mining equipment near Stillwater. It also references a proposed merger under which the combined parent would be renamed BlockFuel Energy Limited; no terms, price, premium, advisors or timing were disclosed. Watch for merger approval milestones and well results as catalysts.
